correctness.rationale: PASS: For r>=4, A,B>0, any hub-outside indicator cut with s proper rim vertices has crossing conductance As+B times at least 2 rim transitions, with equality exactly a contiguous arc; full rim has Ar. For arbitrary metrics dihedral averaging preserves energies; hub spoke average a and rim neighbor b give t=b/a in [0,2], and c_k<=min(2a,min(k,r-k)b). The resulting affine-fractional ratio is maximal at t=0 or t=2/s; each endpoint is realized by rotation average of an arc cut, proving metric target equality to maximal cut. Direct comparison yields threshold B/A>=floor(r²/4)/2; cross multiplication gives staircase and expansion yields 4-8sqrt(2/r)+O(1/r). Independent rational enumeration checked 28 wheel/conductance instances.
